about_short_description.short_description: Ascend is a developer of an insurance payments platform that offers automated payments in financing, collections, and payables.

product.name: Ascend Insurance Financial Operations Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing insurance billing, payments, premium financing, cash application, carrier payables, and reconciliation in one system.

product.name: Billing & Invoicing
product.description: Automates insurance invoice generation, premium collection, commission tracking, and payment reminders for agency-billed and financed policies.

product.name: Direct Bill Automation
product.description: Automates the ingestion, extraction, matching, and reconciliation of carrier commission statements with policy and accounting records.

product.name: Cash Application
product.description: Matches incoming deposits and payments to insurance receivables, helping teams reconcile cash and maintain accurate accounting records.

product.name: Premium Financing & Payments
product.description: Provides insurance premium financing and digital payment workflows, including payment plans, autopay, reminders, and automated collection activity.

product.name: Carrier Payables
product.description: Automates the calculation, funding, tracking, and disbursement of carrier and wholesaler payments associated with insurance policies.
